description: IMP-258: the closed list of what a brief v2 does not anchor. Everything else that states something carries a [[...]] citation of its source.

places.0.2: status and certainty are counts of the body
places.6.3: the cascade is computed from the previous version
places.7.1: open items are rows of gaps.md
places.7.2: seeded marks are counts of the body
places.8.1: assumptions are inferences with their own ASM row
places.A.provenance: provenance is computed from the citations

line_kinds.heading: a title
line_kinds.table: a table row; tables in the body are indexes or counts
line_kinds.pending: a pending mark points to its gap instead
line_kinds.inferred: an inference carries its ASM row
line_kinds.out_of_scope: an out-of-scope line points to its destination
line_kinds.verdict: a verdict computed from the counts
